name: Natural Furniture
old_description: At Natural Furniture, we're passionate about bringing the beauty of solid wood into your home. Since 1975, we've been Portland, OR's go-to destination for high-quality, customizable furniture that stands the test of time. Our locally owned store offers a unique blend of craftsmanship and personalization, ensuring you'll find pieces that perfectly match your style and needs.
about:
Natural Furniture has operated in Portland, Oregon since 1975. The locally owned store is led by Adam Jelsing and a team of design enthusiasts. It began as a destination for solid wood furniture and has grown into a showroom offering both curated collections and customizable pieces.

The company sells and customizes solid wood furniture across categories including bedroom, dining, home office, living room, kids', kitchen, entry, lighting, and outdoor pieces. Services include custom finishing, bespoke sizing, special orders from thousands of additional products, and same- or next-day delivery in the Portland metro area. The showroom carries brands such as Whittier, Archbold, Coaster, Whitewood, T and L, and Mako.

Natural Furniture serves residential customers throughout the Portland metropolitan area, providing furniture for homeowners, interior designers, and anyone furnishing a home. Examples include custom bookcases for home libraries, solid wood dining tables for family gatherings, and ergonomic home office desks for remote workers.

The company emphasizes its 50-year legacy, personalized service, and a limited lifetime warranty on products. It positions itself as a partner in creating homes that reflect the customer's style, combining craftsmanship with customization.
